name: Falena
description:
The Falena bear the features of insects — foremost among them the moth, though the family is broad. Fine antennae rise from their brows, lending them a subtle sensitivity to the emotions and intentions of those nearby. Most have wings, delicate and patterned like stained glass; others have dextrous legs and feet that can cling to any surface.

Height: 3-6' | Weight: 50-250 lbs | Average Lifespan: 50 years | Speed: 30
